systems.system: Système intégré de gestion des ressources humaines des fonctions publiques de l'État et des collectivités (SIGRH)
systems.owner: Ministère de la Refondation de l'État, through the commission in charge of SIGRH
systems.tiers: a reference register of the staff of the state and of the collectivités territoriales; enrolment done by teams sent to the regions, not said to be used in local government offices

note: A central human resources register that counts local government staff, enrolled biometrically by visiting teams between May 2022 and January 2026; the document does not say any local government office works in it or is connected.
